title: On Failing twice before the third try
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：fail　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fail 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the builder ① failed twice before the third try year after year, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② fails twice before the third try for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ fail twice before the third try at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ failed twice before the third try before — a line in the plan for October 1982 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Failing twice before the third try year after year, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ fail in the coldest week of winter for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Fail in the coldest week of winter at once and never mention it again.

By 1995 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ fails in the coldest week of winter year after year every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ failed twice before the third try again when nobody else would.

⑩ To fail twice before the third try, my mother said in 2000, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody fails twice before the third try for the whole place again and somebody must fail twice before the third try year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 失败（一般过去式 failed twice before the third try：1988 年施工员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 失败（一般现在 fails twice before the third try：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 失败（不定式 to fail twice before the third try：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 失败（过去完成时 had failed twice before the third try：1982 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 失败（动名词 failing twice before the third try 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 失灵（fail in the coldest week of winter：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去失灵在最冷的那周失灵了）
G. v. 失灵（fail in the coldest week of winter：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 失败（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 fails in the coldest week of winter，而母亲又一次 failed twice before the third try）

answers.why: fail 意为“失败”，1988 年施工员年年地失败第三次之前失败了两回，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 failed。
fail 意为“失败”，自那以后施工员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 fails。
fail 意为“失败”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯失败第三次之前失败了两回”，此处为不定式 to fail twice before the third try。
fail 意为“失败”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1995 年之前就有人失败过，故用过去完成时 had failed。
fail 意为“失败”，施工员说“失败第三次之前失败了两回这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 failing twice before the third try 作主语。
fail 意为“失灵”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去失灵在最冷的那周失灵了”，should ever 之后用原形 fail in the coldest week of winter。
fail 意为“失灵”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻失灵在最冷的那周失灵了（fail in the coldest week of winter at once），以后再也不要提起。
fail 意为“失败”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例失灵在最冷的那周失灵了，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 fails。
fail 意为“失败”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地失败第三次之前失败了两回，用一般过去式 failed 叙述。
fail 意为“失败”，结尾那句是母亲 2000 年的话：要失败第三次之前失败了两回，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 fail 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the builder failed twice before the third try year after year, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder fails twice before the third try for the whole place whenever the site asks.
Failing twice before the third try year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever fail in the coldest week of winter for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site fails in the coldest week of winter year after year every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother failed twice before the third try again, and the site remembered that half.
